ideas.title: The Investigation into Joe Kent
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's investigation into former counterterrorism chief Joe Kent and the potential leak of classified information.
ideas.angle: The investigation and its potential consequences
questions: What is the extent of the leak?
ideas.insight: This story is significant as it highlights the potential security threats and the importance of investigating leaks of classified information.

ideas.title: The Safety of Self-Driving Technology
ideas.description: This story would investigate the safety of self-driving technology, including Tesla's FSD feature.
ideas.angle: The development and deployment of self-driving technology
questions: How are companies addressing these concerns?
ideas.insight: This story is significant as it highlights the growing concerns over the development and deployment of self-driving technology.
